changelog: Fixed 3D Raycast placement — now uses thread-flag pattern with IsDisabledControl for reliable input detection.
Added blip toggle command (/yankton blips) and 3D marker toggle (/yankton markers).
Admin panel now has a Players tab showing all players in North Yankton with expel button.
Blips tab added — toggle, edit and add blips live from in-game without restarting.
Fixed file load order to prevent function-undefined crashes on script start.
Added per-player flight cooldown to prevent teleport spam.
Added automatic waypoint on arrival at destination.
NUI raycast callback now closes correctly before starting placement mode.
